findings.title: 8 of 15 booking-driving attributes have no rule that varies them
findings.detail: selection.hotelId (Hotel chosen from the results); selection.roomCode (Room type chosen on the hotel details page); extras.code (Optional ancillary added to the cart (empty = none)); extras.quantity (Quantity of the ancillary); guest.email (Where the confirmation e-mail goes); payment.token (Token from the secure payment component; raw card numbers are never accepted); consent.privacyNoticeAccepted (Guest confirmed the privacy notice); request.idempotencyKeyPrefix (Prefix of the Idempotency-Key sent with a reservation (the full key is 8 to 64 characters))
findings.suggestion: Ask for a rule or an example per attribute in the epic; until then no test changes these attributes.
